title: Hopeverse: Tamil Dance Number (Broken Heritage kuthu)
story: A Tamil film dance number: the hero and the crowd take over the street festival.

brief.notes: Jithesh 29 Oct: a dance track for a Tamil movie, fusion, fresh sounds, but keeping the Tamil/Telugu dance style. Study in music-scoring.md 8e. Composition plan so the nadai-change surprise and the showdown land on time.

positive_global_styles: South Indian film dance number, street festival energy, composed like a film composer, not a DJ mix
kuthu groove: big live thappu and parai frame drums in a swung triplet feel, about 100 BPM
thavil pitched down as the bass, chopped and bent nadaswaram as the lead synth, ghatam and kanjira as glitchy top percussion
crowd chant of konnakol syllables as the hook, group 'hey' shouts
loud, clear, punchy mix with deep drums

positive_local_styles: a bent nadaswaram synth plays a rising 3-note call: root, minor third, fifth, held and bent up
a lone parai teases the swing
one crowd 'hey'
full thappu and parai triplet groove crashes in
call-and-response 'hey' shouts
pitched-down thavil bass
crowd chants konnakol syllables on the groove
chopped nadaswaram riff answers each chant
ghatam and kanjira glitch fills
lines: ta ka dhi mi, ta ka jhu nu
ta ka dhi mi, ta ka jhu nu

positive_local_styles: drummers play a pickup fill that speeds up
brass climbs
one reversed veena swell into a huge unison hit
the rhythm switches from triplet swing to a straight four-beat dappu pattern, a surprise change of gait
the main hook: crowd chant and brass in unison
everyone dances one move
lines: dhi mi dhi mi, ta ka ta!

positive_local_styles: back to the triplet swing
only drums and konnakol voice trading phrases, speeding up
ends on a phrase played three times that lands exactly on beat one
lines: ta ka dhi mi ta, ta ka dhi mi ta, ta ka dhi mi ta

positive_local_styles: highest energy: full triplet kuthu groove, brass, strings, crowd chant, nadaswaram synth lead
louder than the first hook
lines: ta ka dhi mi, ta ka jhu nu, hey!

positive_local_styles: the 3-note call again on the nadaswaram synth over the drums
one big unison hit, then stop
